comment: TASK-004: the single pinned identity of the upstream Pi checkout. Read by scripts/prepare.mjs (local) and by .github/workflows/ci.yml (CI, through the same script). Never replace the commit with a branch name, a tag, or a registry version.
buildNote: Topological order of the workspace dependency closure of the five linked packages. pi-ai depends on pi-telemetry (src/types.ts imports @earendil-works/pi-telemetry), pi-durable depends on chord and pi-ai. pi-tui and pi-mcp have no workspace dependencies of their own. The other seven workspaces (codemode, env, agent, protocol, client, server, coding-agent) are outside that closure and are not built.

modelCatalog.why: packages/ai imports src/providers/data/*.json while compiling, and upstream gitignores that directory: the files are generated, not committed. Upstream's own offline path is the model catalog revision pinned in the checkout's nix/model-catalog.json, so prepare.mjs reads that revision, downloads it, checks that the bytes hash back to the revision, and runs upstream's hydrate-model-catalog.ts. No live catalog refresh happens, and hydration is byte-deterministic (it stamps a fixed manifest time).

verified.note: The commit was fetched by SHA from the repository above (git fetch --depth 1 origin <sha>), so CI can reproduce the exact same tree without a full clone.
